cap: Theca cells, next to capillaries, use LH to turn cholesterol into androstenedione but have little aromatase. Granulosa cells, inside the basement membrane, use FSH-induced aromatase to convert that androgen into estrone and estradiol. Neither cell can make estradiol alone, which is why a follicle needs both gonadotropins. Aromatase in fat performs the same conversion outside the ovary and makes estrone, the main estrogen after menopause.
